components.css: :host{--ground:#EEE7DA;--stock:#F8F4EC;--ink:#2A2420;--ink-2:#6B5D50;--rule:rgba(42,36,32,.16);--rule-strong:rgba(42,36,32,.32);--gilt:#7A5C17;--mannequin:#DDD3C3;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--serif:"Gloock","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;--sans:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;} .ds-masthead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:14px 20px 12px;background:var(--ground);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);}.ds-wordmark{font:400 1.75rem/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--ink);}.ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;}.ds-tab{position:relative;min-height:44px;padding:0 10px;border:0;background:none;font:500 0.9375rem/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--ink-2);cursor:pointer;}.ds-tab::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:8px;height:1.5px;background:var(--ink);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform 240ms var(--ease-out);}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"],.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--ink);}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after{transform:scaleX(1);}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Colour Band
components.description: The atom of the card: flat colour field with its shade number printed on it, name below; selected shows the inset ring, pale gets a filete.
components.css: :host{--ground:#EEE7DA;--stock:#F8F4EC;--ink:#2A2420;--ink-2:#6B5D50;--rule:rgba(42,36,32,.16);--rule-strong:rgba(42,36,32,.32);--gilt:#7A5C17;--mannequin:#DDD3C3;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--serif:"Gloock","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;--sans:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;} .ds-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(76px,1fr));gap:12px 4px;padding:16px;background:var(--stock);}.ds-band{display:block;width:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-band__field{position:relative;display:block;height:56px;background:var(--c);}.ds-is-pale .ds-band__field{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule);}.ds-band__no{position:absolute;left:6px;bottom:4px;font-size:0.6875rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1;color:var(--on);}.ds-band__name{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink);}.ds-band:hover .ds-band__name{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-thickness:1px;}.ds-band[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-band__field{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--c),inset 0 0 0 4.5px var(--on);}.ds-band[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-band__no{left:10px;bottom:9px;}.ds-band[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-band__name{font-weight:600;}.ds-band__owned{position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;width:12px;height:12px;fill:none;stroke:var(--on);stroke-width:2;}.ds-band:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;}

components.css: :host{--ground:#EEE7DA;--stock:#F8F4EC;--ink:#2A2420;--ink-2:#6B5D50;--rule:rgba(42,36,32,.16);--rule-strong:rgba(42,36,32,.32);--gilt:#7A5C17;--mannequin:#DDD3C3;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--serif:"Gloock","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;--sans:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;} .ds-free{display:grid;justify-items:start;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;font:600 0.8125rem/1.25 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);}.ds-free input{width:76px;height:52px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;}.ds-free input::-webkit-color-swatch-wrapper{padding:0;}.ds-free input::-webkit-color-swatch{border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule);}.ds-free input::-moz-color-swatch{border:0;border-radius:0;}.ds-free input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;}

narrative.overview:
Swatch is printed, not rendered. The screen is a sheet of bone card stock with lighter card panels laid on it, printed in one sepia ink, with a single gilt reserved for the owner's classics. Every garment colour is a flat, square-cornered band with its shade number (Nº 01 to 18) printed in small tabular figures on the band itself, filed by family the way a thread card is. Choosing a colour pulls its companions into matching strips; the colour field is the control, and nothing around it is allowed to tint, shade or frame it.

Density is that of a reference card: tight 4px gutters between bands, generous 40px breathing between blocks, hierarchy carried by type scale alone (a large Gloock serif against small Figtree UI text) rather than by weight, colour or chrome. State is a printed mark inside the cell, never a lift or glow: a ring for the selected band, a ✓ stroke for owned colours, a ★ in gilt for a classic. Motion is mechanical and short: an underline that draws, strips that slide 6px into place, and a real vertical-axis flip when top and bottom trade places on the figure.

The world rejects the category default of round colour dots on white cards with drop shadows and a bottom sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Bone ground, lighter stock panels, one sepia ink, one gilt.
Flat bands, zero radius, no drop shadows; inset hairlines only where a pale swatch would vanish.
Shade numbers printed on the band in the band's own contrasting ink.
Serif display for names and headings, sans for everything operable.
State drawn as printed marks inside the cell.

rules.name: The Colour Is Content Rule
rules.body: Garment colours appear only inside bands, strips, the silhouette and the 60-30-10 bar. The chrome is ground, stock, ink and rule; nothing else.

rules.name: The One Gilt Rule
rules.body: Gilt marks the owner's own classics and nothing else. If it is not a classic, it is printed in ink.

rules.name: The Printed-On Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a band is set in whichever of ink or stock has the higher contrast against that band, computed per colour (the `--on` value). Never pick band text colour by hand.

rules.name: The Scale Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from the jump between serif display sizes and small sans labels. Serif text is always weight 400; sans never goes above 600.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is tabular (set on body), so shade numbers and ordinals align like a printed index.

rules.name: The Band Gap Rule
rules.body: Bands that belong together sit 4px apart, never more; space larger than that means a different group.

rules.name: The Printed Mark Rule
rules.body: Depth and state are printed inside the cell (inset hairline, inset ring, stroke mark), never cast outside it. If it lifts, glows or casts, it is not this world.

rules.name: The Square Card Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 everywhere in the interface. A round swatch is the category default this world refuses.

dos: Do print every colour as a flat, square band with its shade number on it, and always set its name next to it.
Do compute band ink per colour (ink or stock, whichever contrasts more) and add the inset 1px rule filete when a swatch is pale.
Do show state as a mark inside the cell: the inset ring for selected, a stroked ✓ for owned, a gilt ★ for a classic.
Do keep bands in a group 4px apart and separate blocks by 40px.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px tall.
Do honour reduced motion: every transition and animation collapses to 1ms.
donts: Don't round any corner of the interface (radius 0px everywhere).
Don't cast drop shadows or lift surfaces; inset printed lines are the only shadow syntax.
Don't use gilt for anything but the owner's classics.
Don't put garment colours into chrome (backgrounds, borders, text).
Don't set a serif in anything but weight 400, or use emoji or font glyphs for marks; ★, ✓ and icons are inline SVG.
